HOUSE PROBE SOUGHT VS DOLOMITE PROJECT

Bicol Saro Party-list Rep. Terry Ridon has filed House Resolution No. 56, urging a congressional probe into the ₱389M Dolomite Beach project, which MMDA says worsened Manila flooding.

Ridon slams the project as wasteful, unapproved, and environmentally harmful, warning: “If it meets the threshold for plunder—so be it.”

@News5PH @onenewsph

TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Magsasagawa ng RESCUE M.A.R.C.H (Mass Assembly for Rescue and Care for Humanity) ang iba't ibang grupo mula sa national government agencies, local government units, uniformed services, private sectors, at volunteer groups simula 4:00am sa Sabado, July 19.

Magsisimula ang martsa sa MMDA Motorcycle Riding Academy sa Pasig City at magtatapos sa UP Science Park.

Nasa 15.3 kilometro ang tinatayang distansya ng lalakarin ng nasa 700 participants at nasa 4 hanggang 5 oras ang inaasahang tagal ng gagawing aktibidad.

Walang isasarang kalsada at stop and go scheme ang ipatutupad sa mga kalsadang madadaanan.

Ang aktibidad ay para masukat ang endurance ng mga rescuer kasabay ng pagsu-showcase ng kanilang rescue equipment bilang paghahanda sakaling mangyari ang pinangangambahang pagtama ng 7.2 magnitude na lindol o "The Big One" sa Metro Manila.

#mmda #rescuemarchchallenge2025
